config.engine: live SimulationRunner (blinded control-vs-treatment stimulus, generic conversion metric)
config.headline: direction_accuracy

baselines_to_beat.strongest_constant: always-treatment = 9/15 = 0.600 (the set is treatment-leaning; the headline must beat 0.600, NOT just 0.5, to be non-trivial)

prediction_of_record.CRITICAL_diagnostic_per_class: I predict a LARGE per-class gap: treatment-class dir_acc HIGH (~0.85-1.0, ~8-9 of 9) but control-class dir_acc LOW (~0.33, ~2 of 6 — gets cookiecats gate-timing + msn_homepage clutter right; MISSES office_online, cxl, multistep [the v2.1 'simplification/redesign-wins' prior misses] AND etsy infinite-scroll [counter-intuitive: a pro-change tilt predicts the modern infinite-scroll wins, but control won]).
prediction_of_record.interpretation_if_confirmed: A headline that beats always-treatment ONLY because the set is treatment-heavy and the sim has a residual pro-change tilt is NOT a certified balanced positive. The decisive evidence is the per-class gap: if treatment-class >> control-class, the sim is still echoing a pro-change prior on the hard control-won cases, not reasoning symmetrically.
prediction_of_record.rank_rho: predict positive (v2.1 was +0.57), p likely > 0.05 at n=15.

decision_rule.certified_positive_requires: dir_acc beats always-treatment (0.600) with a margin AND control-class dir_acc is NOT collapsed (>= ~0.5) AND cert passes — i.e. genuine BALANCED discrimination, not a treatment-tilt artifact. Report binomial significance vs 0.5 and vs 0.600.
decision_rule.if_headline_high_but_control_class_colla: Report as 'power increased, residual pro-change prior on hard control-won cases persists' -> the lever is #221 (de-bias the pro-change prior at outcome elicitation), NOT a victory lap. Still SUGGESTIVE, not certified.
decision_rule.if_control_class_holds_and_beats_baselin: FIRST genuinely balanced in-scope signal -> strengthen toward the sellable claim; expand further for significance.

honesty_notes: The 7 new cases were selected for VALIDITY (verified primary source + in-scope + audit-clean), not winner direction; the treatment-lean is an artifact of which real cases are obtainable (publication bias), reported transparently.
n=15 is a power step, not a guarantee of significance; to clear chance at ~0.7 needs ~11-12/15 (one-sided binomial p~0.06 at 11/15).

Memorization risk: amazon/hotmail/pinterest/etsy are medium-memo (eng-famous); price_com/msn_support/linkedin low. If the sim aces only the famous ones, suspect recitation (cross-check vs the held-out probe pattern).
